description: Get a single space by its `id` OR its `slug` (provide exactly one). Returns the space's name, slug, description, type, creation date, and member/post counts. Bettermode GraphQL query: space.

id.description: The space's id. Provide this OR `slug`.

slug.description: The space's URL slug. Provide this OR `id`.

name: bettermode_get_space
title: Get space
